title: Nightmares of Newborn Manor
description: In Nightmares of Newborn Manor, adventurers must brave a haunted estate where the echoes of infant cries twist into sinister omens. Once a proud home, the manor now groans under the weight of sleepless terrors, spectral toys, and cursed relics of parenthood. To survive, heroes must face the trials of endless diapers, bottle-born horrors, and lullabies that lull the soul toward doom. Only through courage—and perhaps a bit of humor—can the party escape the cradle of despair.
